usage.callShape: GET https://httpay.xyz/api/news?topic=tech (x402, ~$0.005 USDC on Base). NOTE: GET-only — POST returns 404 despite registry listing POST.
usage.outputShape: body.headlines[] (each: .title, .url, .source, .pubDate, .snippet, .categories[]); body.count = number of headlines; body.topic = echoed topic; body.availableTopics[] = valid topics
quirks: Registry lists POST but the endpoint is GET-only — POST https://httpay.xyz/api/news returns 404 'Cannot POST /api/news'. Call it as GET.
Topic is passed as a URL query param (?topic=tech), NOT a JSON body.
Valid topics: tech, ai, world, science, business, crypto, health, sports. Default is tech if omitted.
Facilitator confirmed flag was false but the call was paid ($0.005) and returned 200 with real data.
usage.guide: Call GET https://httpay.xyz/api/news with a ?topic= query param (e.g. ?topic=ai). Do NOT use POST — POST returns 404; this is a GET endpoint despite the registry CALL line. Valid topics: tech, ai, world, science, business, crypto, health, sports (default tech). Pay via x402 (~$0.005 USDC on Base). Read results from body.headlines[] — each item has title, url, source, pubDate, snippet, categories[]. body.count tells you how many (20).
